# Support

## Getting help

1. **Documentation first.** Check the [README](../README.md),
   [docs/](../docs/) and the methodology pages — most questions about
   setup, runtimes, and result interpretation are answered there.
2. **Search existing issues** before opening a new one.
3. **Ask a question** via
   [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/webdevsamran/local-ai-hardware-bench/discussions).
4. **Report a bug** using the bug report issue template.

## What to include

For hardware/runtime problems, attach the sanitized output of:

```bash
aihwbench system-info
aihwbench doctor
```

Detection output is sanitized by design (no serials, MACs, usernames,
home paths). Never paste tokens, credentials, or personal paths.

## Security issues

Do not open public issues for security vulnerabilities. Use
[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/webdevsamran/local-ai-hardware-bench/security/advisories/new)
— see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

## Response expectations

This is a community-maintained open-source project; responses are
best-effort. Maintainers triage issues when time allows.
